strings.trophy.botola.name: Botola Pro
strings.trophy.botola.text: 22 titles — Wydad Athletic Club has won 22 Botola Pro league titles, making them the most decorated club in Moroccan football history.
strings.trophy.caf.name: CAF Champions League
strings.trophy.caf.text: 3 continental titles: 1992, 2017, 2022. The 2022 final was played in Casablanca against Al Ahly.
strings.trophy.throne.name: Throne Cup
strings.trophy.throne.text: 9 Throne Cups — the most prestigious cup competition in Moroccan football.
strings.trophy.super.name: CAF Super Cup

q1.q: When was Wydad Athletic Club founded?
q1.fact: Wydad was founded in 1937 in Casablanca.

q2.q: How many Botola Pro titles has Wydad won?
q2.fact: 22 titles — the most in the history of Moroccan football.

q3.q: Where does Wydad play its home matches?
q3.fact: Stade Mohamed V in Casablanca is Wydad's home.

q4.q: How many CAF Champions League titles has Wydad won?

q6.fact: Wissam Ben Yedder — ex-Monaco and French international, joined Wydad in 2025.

q7.q: Where was the 2022 CAF Champions League final played?
q7.fact: The 2022 final was played at Stade Mohamed V — an African derby against Al Ahly.

q8.q: Which Moroccan defensive midfielder joined Wydad?
q8.fact: Sofiane Amrabat — a 2022 World Cup star and a strong defensive midfielder.

q9.q: How many Throne Cups has Wydad won?
q9.fact: 9 Throne Cups — the most prestigious cup in Moroccan football.

q10.q: Which Moroccan right winger joined Wydad?
q10.fact: Hakim Ziyech — Morocco international, joined Wydad in 2025.
